Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.26.0 upgrades the project-created two-seat helicopter to presentation V0.4: a merged low-poly red/white cabin and tail, visible dual seats and dashboard, independent solid/blur rotor parts, frame-rate-independent rotor states, bounded visual-only flight attitude, and a lifecycle-managed distance-attenuated clean-room WAV loop. Driver-only flight, two-seat roles, native body collision/save and existing network paths are preserved. Android 7723 rendering/audio/save reload and real two-device multiplayer remain pending verification.
Author: SCIE-Port contributors; upstream authors credited in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
